India's indigenous Netra airborne surveillance system receives final clearance

India's indigenous Netra Airborne Early Warning and Control (AEW&C) system has received its Final Operational Clearance (FOC) from the Indian Air Force (IAF). This clearance signifies the system is combat-ready and enhances India's airborne surveillance and air power capabilities. The Netra system is a significant indigenous defense achievement, making India one of the few nations to develop such technology.
